items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Coach Happy. The Red Happy. I can't picture that trombone player. [INTERVIEWEE] I can see the cooperators... I can't remember. Another one, Morris Frankel...

ctx.x: He didn't play with Buddy when I was playing with him. Yeah. No, indeed. No. He might have played with Chris Kelly. He might have. He might have played with Chris, because there wasn't too much to Chris. He was kind of popular, you know. Never had no kind of band. He ain't happy playing with him once. He had a pretty, fair band.
Coach Happy. The Red Happy. I can't picture that trombone player.

I can see the cooperators, cooperators, all, and economy all. I can see ourselves sitting there playing, but now who's that trombone? I can't remember. Another one, Morris Frankel, he was playing with René at the time. When I was playing with Buddy Petit, how come to play with Sam Morgan, Buddy Petit had Manny Gabriel.
